items.title: Refining Treatment Monitoring in Patients With Relapsing Multiple Sclerosis Based on Changes on Neurofilament Light Chain Z-Scores.
items.abstract: Serum neurofilament light chain (sNfL) reflects inflammatory axonal damage in relapsing multiple sclerosis (RMS). Longitudinal sNfL dynamics may aid treatment response assessment, although data on expected changes under disease-modifying treatments remain limited, particularly in real-world practice. This study evaluated whether on-treatment changes in sNfL were associated with subsequent evidence of disease activity (EDA) and whether they provided complementary information to established treatment response scoring systems (TRSS). This prospective, real-world cohort study was conducted at the Multiple Sclerosis Center of Catalonia (Cemcat). Adult RMS patients initiating disease-modifying treatments (DMTs) with serum samples at treatment initiation (baseline) and after 1 year (Y1) were included. The primary exposure was change in sNfL z-scores (ΔzNfL = zNfLY1 - zNfL-baseline) analyzed using data-derived thresholds (ΔzNfL ≥0 and <0.5-point reduction). At Y1, Expanded Disability Status Scale progression, clinical/radiologic activity, and TRSS (Rio [RS], modified Rio [mRS], and MAGNIMS) were assessed. The primary outcome was EDA between years 1 and 2 (EDA-Y2). Multivariable logistic regression models evaluated associations between ΔzNfL and EDA-Y2, as well as the added value of ΔzNfL across TRSS strata. A total of 329 patients (66.3% female; median age 39 years) initiated 352 DMTs; 342 remained on treatment for ≥1 year and 182 had complete EDA-Y2 data. Mean (SD) ΔzNfL at Y1 was -0.62 (1.2), with greater reductions in monoclonal antibody-treated and treatment-naïve patients. Lack of zNfL reduction over the first year (ΔzNfL ≥0) was associated with higher odds of EDA-Y2 in the overall cohort (OR [95% CI], p: 3.07 [1.47-6.39], 0.003), in treatment-naïve cases (14.04 [2.47-79.93], 0.003), and in those achieving No Evidence of Disease Activity (NEDA-3) at Y1 (4.54 [1.26-16.30], 0.02). Similar associations were observed for <0.5-point reductions. Adding ΔzNfL to TRSS showed persistent associations with EDA-Y2 despite otherwise favorable scores [e.g., RS: 2.26 (1.12-4.59), 0.024]. Failure to reduce zNfL levels after 1 year of treatment was associated with subsequent disease activity, even in patients otherwise considered stable, providing complementary information to clinical and MRI-based monitoring. Limitations include incomplete follow-up and the modest discriminative performance of ΔzNfL, supporting a complementary rather than stand-alone role for zNfL dynamics.
items.summary_ja:
背景：再発型多発性硬化症（RMS）における血清ニューロフィラメントライト鎖（sNfL）は炎症性軸索損傷の指標であり、その経時的変化は治療効果の評価に有用とされるが、実臨床での変化パターンは不明確である。  
方法：カタルーニャ多発性硬化症センターで、疾患修飾治療（DMT）開始時と1年後にsNfLを測定した成人RMS患者329名を対象に、sNfLのzスコア変化（ΔzNfL）と1～2年目の疾患活動（EDA）との関連を前向きに解析。既存の治療反応スコアリングシステム（TRSS）との補完的価値も検討した。  
結果：1年後の平均ΔzNfLは-0.62で、モノクローナル抗体治療や治療未経験者で減少が大きかった。ΔzNfLが減少しない（≥0）患者はEDA発症リスクが有意に高く（全体OR=3.07、治療未経験者OR=14.04）、NEDA-3達成例でも同様の傾向を示した。ΔzNfLをTRSSに加えると、良好なスコア群でもEDA予測能が向上した。  
結論：治療開始後1年でsNfLレベルが減少しないことは、その後の疾患活動と関連し、臨床・MRI評価を補完する有用なバイオマーカーとなる。ただし、単独での判別能は限定的であり、補助的指標としての活用が望ましい。
items.summary_short_ja: 再発型多発性硬化症患者において、治療開始から1年後の血清神経細胞軽鎖（sNfL）Zスコア変化（ΔzNfL）が、その後の疾患活動（EDA）発現と関連するかを検証した。ΔzNfLが減少しない患者は、治療効果良好とされる群でもEDAリスクが高く、既存の治療反応評価スコアに補完的な情報を提供した。ΔzNfLは単独指標ではなく、臨床・画像評価と併用すべきである。

items.title: Effect of a ≥50% Reduction in Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol From Baseline in Patients With Ischemic Stroke.
items.abstract: Current secondary atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease prevention guidelines recommend both a ≥50% reduction in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) from baseline and an absolute LDL-C goal (<70 or <55 mg/dL). Stroke-specific guidelines primarily emphasize only an absolute LDL-C goal, and the independent clinical impact of achieving a ≥50% reduction remains unclear in patients with ischemic stroke. This study aimed to evaluate whether achieving a ≥50% LDL-C reduction provides prognostic benefit independent of attaining an absolute LDL-C goal in patients with ischemic stroke. This retrospective cohort study included patients admitted for acute ischemic stroke (2014-2022) using the Korean National Health Insurance Database in South Korea. LDL-C status over time was derived from serial national health examinations following the index stroke. Patients were categorized into 4 groups according to attainment of absolute (<70 mg/dL) and relative (≥50% reduction from baseline) LDL-C goals. The primary outcome was a composite of recurrent stroke, myocardial infarction, and all-cause death, analyzed using time-varying Cox regression. Among 89,414 patients, 136,427 poststroke LDL-C measurements were analyzed over a mean follow-up of 5.72 ± 2.40 years. Throughout the follow-up period, the proportion of patients achieving a ≥50% LDL-C reduction from baseline remained at approximately 30%. Using the optimal group (achieving both <70 mg/dL and ≥50% reduction) as the reference, the risk of the primary outcome was significantly higher in groups failing to achieve a ≥50% reduction, regardless of attainment of the absolute LDL-C level (<70 mg/dL): adjusted hazard ratio [95% CI] 1.12 [1.06-1.18] for the <70 mg/dL and <50% reduction group and 1.28 [1.23-1.34] for the ≥70 mg/dL and <50% reduction group. Results were consistent across subgroups stratified by sex, age, baseline LDL-C level, and the presence of presumed cardioembolic source. Achieving a ≥50% reduction in LDL-C from baseline was independently associated with a lower risk of secondary cardiovascular events. A substantial proportion of patients with ischemic stroke fail to achieve optimal LDL-C reduction; thus, more intensive and multifaceted lipid-lowering strategies focusing on both absolute and relative LDL-C reduction may lead to improved long-term outcomes.
items.summary_ja: 背景：虚血性脳卒中患者の二次予防において、LDLコレステロール（LDL-C）を基準値から50%以上減少させることの独立した臨床効果は不明であった。方法：韓国国民健康保険データベースを用い、2014～2022年に急性虚血性脳卒中で入院した89,414例を対象に、発症後のLDL-C測定値から絶対目標値（<70 mg/dL）および相対目標（基準値から≥50%減少）の達成状況で4群に分類し、再発脳卒中、心筋梗塞、全死亡を複合した主要転帰を追跡した。結果：平均5.7年の追跡期間中、基準値から50%以上のLDL-C減少を達成した患者は約30%にとどまった。絶対目標を達成していても50%減少を達成しない群は、主要転帰リスクが有意に高かった（調整ハザード比1.12～1.28）。性別、年齢、基準LDL-C値、心原性塞栓の有無に関わらず結果は一貫していた。結論：虚血性脳卒中患者において、LDL-Cを基準値から50%以上減少させることは、絶対目標達成の有無にかかわらず二次心血管イベントリスクの低減に独立して寄与する。より強化された多面的な脂質管理戦略が長期予後改善に重要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 虚血性脳卒中患者において、LDLコレステロール（LDL-C）を基準値から50%以上減少させることが、絶対値目標（<70 mg/dL）達成の有無にかかわらず、再発脳卒中や心筋梗塞、死亡リスクの低下と独立して関連することが示された。約9万人の韓国患者を対象にした追跡調査で、両目標達成群が最も良好な予後を示し、より積極的な脂質管理の重要性が示唆された。

items.title: The Prognostic Value of Paramagnetic Rim Lesions in People With Multiple Sclerosis.
items.abstract: Paramagnetic rim lesions (PRLs) have been established as a radiologic surrogate for chronic active inflammation in multiple sclerosis (MS). Although associations between PRLs and disability have been observed, data on their prognostic value for long-term risk of clinical worsening, especially in the form of progression independent of relapse activity (PIRA), remain limited. In this study, we assessed the association of PRLs with future disability accumulation over a median follow-up of 5 years and their relation to other (para) clinical parameters. From a large, ongoing single-center cohort study, people with MS were included according to the availability of susceptibility-sensitive MRI. PRLs were segmented on reconstructed quantitative susceptibility mapping scans using a deep learning-based segmentation model, visually inspected for plausibility, and corrected if necessary. Multivariable Cox proportional hazards models were used to investigate the prognostic value of PRLs for disability outcomes, including confirmed disability accumulation (CDA) and PIRA. Sensitivity analyses based on PRL count, MS diagnosis, prior disability accumulation, and treatment during follow-up were performed to evaluate the robustness of our findings. In addition, associations between PRL status and CSF parameters as well as future brain atrophy, measured by annual percentage brain volume change, were assessed in an exploratory manner. Among 862 participants (mean age 40.3 years, 64.7% female), 395 (45.8%) had at least 1 PRL. Over a median follow-up of 5.1 years, 142 of 801 individuals with clinical follow-up for longitudinal analysis experienced CDA (17.7%), and 104 of these CDA events (73.2%) occurred as PIRA. The presence of PRLs was associated with a higher risk of PIRA (adjusted hazard ratio 1.8, 95% CI 1.1-2.8;  PRLs are associated with an increased risk of future PIRA and accelerated rates of brain atrophy. These findings emphasize their potential as a prognostic biomarker for risk stratification in MS.
items.summary_ja:
背景：多発性硬化症（MS）における慢性活動性炎症の放射線学的指標として、パラ磁性リム病変（PRLs）が注目されているが、長期的な臨床悪化リスク、特に再発活動に依存しない進行（PIRA）に対する予後的価値は不明であった。  
方法：単一施設の大規模コホート研究から、感受性強調MRIが利用可能なMS患者862名を対象に、深層学習を用いた定量的感受性マッピングでPRLsを抽出・確認。中央値5年間の追跡期間中の障害蓄積（CDA）およびPIRA発症リスクとの関連を多変量Cox回帰モデルで解析。さらに、PRL数、診断、既往障害、治療の影響を感度分析し、脳脊髄液パラメータや脳萎縮との関連も探索的に評価した。  
結果：被験者の45.8％にPRLsを認め、801名の追跡中17.7％がCDAを経験、そのうち73.2％がPIRAであった。PRLsの存在はPIRAリスクの有意な増加（調整ハザード比1.8、95％CI 1.1-2.8）および脳萎縮の進行速度上昇と関連した。  
結論：PRLsはMSにおける将来のPIRAリスクおよび脳萎縮進行の予測因子として有用であり、リスク層別化のためのバイオマーカーとしての可能性を示す。
items.summary_short_ja: 多発性硬化症（MS）患者862名を対象に、パラマグネティックリム病変（PRLs）が将来の障害進行、特に再発非依存性進行（PIRA）と脳萎縮速度に与える影響を5年間追跡調査した。PRLsの存在はPIRAリスクを1.8倍に高め、脳萎縮の進行とも関連した。これにより、PRLsはMSの予後予測およびリスク層別化に有用なバイオマーカーであることが示された。

items.title: Effect of Baseline ASPECTS on Tenecteplase Efficacy Before Thrombectomy in Acute Large-Vessel Occlusion Stroke: A Post Hoc Analysis of the BRIDGE-TNK Randomized Trial.
items.abstract: The impact of ischemic extent on the efficacy and safety of intravenous thrombolysis before thrombectomy remains uncertain. The aim of this study was to evaluate whether the baseline ischemic extent, measured by the Alberta Stroke Program Early Computed Tomography Score (ASPECTS), modifies outcomes of intravenous tenecteplase administered before endovascular thrombectomy. This was a post hoc analysis of the BRIDGE-TNK (thrombectomy with vs without rhTNK-tPA in stroke) trial, conducted across China from May 2022 to September 2024. We compared the efficacy and safety of intravenous tenecteplase plus thrombectomy vs thrombectomy alone in acute large-vessel occlusion stroke patients within 4.5 hours of last known well, stratified by baseline ASPECTS (<8 vs 8-10). The outcomes included 90-day functional independence (modified Rankin Scale score of 0-2), 48-hour symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage (sICH), and 90-day mortality. Regression models incorporating a treatment-by-ASPECTS interaction term were used for analysis. Among 550 patients, 241 (43.8%) had ASPECTS <8 (median [interquartile range, IQR] age, 69 [61-77] years; 56.4% male) and 309 had ASPECTS 8-10 (median [IQR] age, 70 [61-77] years; 59.5% male). The rate of functional independence was significantly higher in the tenecteplase plus thrombectomy group than in the thrombectomy-alone group in the ASPECTS <8 subgroup (adjusted risk ratio [aRR], 1.67; 95% CI 1.18-2.35), but not in the ASPECTS 8-10 subgroup (aRR, 0.99; 95% CI 0.84-1.17;  In this exploratory post hoc analysis, a signal of benefit was observed in patients with ASPECTS <8 who received intravenous tenecteplase before thrombectomy, whereas no functional improvement and possible safety concerns were seen in those with ASPECTS 8-10. Prospective confirmation in randomized trials is required before practice change. ClinicalTrials.gov; Unique identifier: NCT04733742.
items.summary_ja: 背景：急性大血管閉塞脳梗塞における血栓除去術前の静脈内血栓溶解療法の効果と安全性は、虚血範囲の影響が不明である。方法：中国で実施されたBRIDGE-TNK試験の事後解析として、初期虚血範囲をASPECTSで評価し、ASPECTS<8群と8-10群に分けて、血栓除去術前にテネクテプラーゼを投与した群と血栓除去術単独群の効果と安全性を比較した。主要評価項目は90日後の機能的自立（mRS 0-2）、48時間以内の症候性頭蓋内出血、90日死亡率である。結果：550例中、241例がASPECTS<8、309例が8-10であった。ASPECTS<8群ではテネクテプラーゼ併用群の機能的自立率が有意に高かった（調整リスク比1.67、95%CI 1.18-2.35）が、ASPECTS 8-10群では差がなかった（調整リスク比0.99、95%CI 0.84-1.17）。結論：ASPECTS<8の患者ではテネクテプラーゼ併用が有益な可能性が示唆されたが、ASPECTS 8-10群では効果不明かつ安全性懸念もあり、臨床応用にはさらなる前向き試験での検証が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: BRIDGE-TNK試験の事後解析で、急性大血管閉塞脳卒中患者における基準ASPECTS値によるテネクテプラーゼ静注療法の効果を検討した。ASPECTS<8群ではテネクテプラーゼ併用が機能的独立性を有意に改善したが、ASPECTS8-10群では効果が認められず安全性懸念も示唆された。基準ASPECTSが低い患者に対するテネクテプラーゼ併用の有用性は今後の無作為試験での検証が必要である。

items.title: Paternal Valproate Exposure and Offspring Neurodevelopmental Outcomes.
items.abstract: Evidence remains inconclusive on whether paternal valproate exposure during spermatogenesis is associated with adverse offspring outcomes, with findings lacking beyond Nordic countries. This study aimed to assess the risks of neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs) and congenital malformations in offspring attributable to paternal exposure to valproate and other antiseizure medications (ASMs) during sperm development. This nationwide birth cohort study used data from the Taiwan National Health Insurance Research Database, including individuals born 2001-2016 who were followed up through 2021. Paternal exposure to valproate or other ASMs was defined during the time of spermatogenesis (3 months before conception). Exposure discordant sibling sets were identified for sibling-comparison analysis to control for shared genetic and lifestyle factors. NDDs-including autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), intellectual disability (ID), and tic disorder-and congenital malformations were defined by outpatient and inpatient medical record(s). Relative risks were estimated through Cox proportional hazards models for NDDs (hazard ratios [HRs]) and logistic regression for congenital malformations (odds ratios [ORs]). In the population cohort of 2,583,503 individuals, 1,701 were exposed to paternal use of valproate and 548 exposure-discordant sibling sets were available for sibling-comparison analysis. In population-based analyses, paternal valproate exposure was not associated with the risk of NDDs (HRs = 0.86 [95% CI 0.61-1.22] for ASD, 1.02 [0.88-1.18] for ADHD, 0.80 [0.53-1.20] for tic disorders, and 0.81 [0.55-1.19] for ID) or congenital malformations (OR = 1.07 [0.83-1.37]) in offspring. These null effects persisted when restricting analyses to children of fathers with epilepsy to control for confounding by indication, and when the sibling-comparison analysis was conducted. For other ASMs, a few associations appeared at nominal significance, but none remained in sibling-comparison analyses. In this large population-based study in Asia, we found no increased risk of NDDs in offspring following paternal exposure to valproate or other ASMs. These findings may contribute to ongoing debates about the management of valproate in men of reproductive age, although additional evidence is needed before drawing conclusions about changes to current practice.
items.summary_ja: 本研究は、父親のバルプロ酸（valproate）曝露が子の神経発達障害（NDD）や先天異常に与える影響を検討した。台湾の国民健康保険データベースを用い、2001～2016年出生の約258万人を対象に、受精前3か月間の精子形成期における父親のバルプロ酸や他の抗てんかん薬（ASM）使用を曝露と定義。自家対照として曝露不一致の兄弟セットも分析した。結果、バルプロ酸曝露は自閉症スペクトラム障害（ASD）、注意欠陥多動性障害（ADHD）、チック障害、知的障害（ID）、先天異常のリスク上昇と関連せず（HRやORは有意差なし）、てんかん患者の父親に限定しても同様であった。他のASMについても有意な関連は兄弟比較で消失した。結論として、アジアの大規模コホートで父親のバルプロ酸曝露は子のNDDリスク増加を示さず、男性の生殖年齢におけるバルプロ酸管理の議論に重要な知見を提供するが、臨床方針変更にはさらなる証拠が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は台湾の全国出生コホートを用い、父親の精子形成期におけるバルプロ酸および他の抗てんかん薬（ASM）曝露が子の神経発達障害（自閉症、ADHD、知的障害、チック障害）や先天異常に与える影響を検討した。結果、バルプロ酸曝露はこれらのリスク増加と関連せず、兄弟比較分析でも同様の結果が得られた。これにより、父親のバルプロ酸使用が子の神経発達に悪影響を及ぼす証拠は見られなかった。

items.title: Application of the 2024 McDonald Criteria: Earlier Diagnosis and Avoiding Misdiagnosis of Multiple Sclerosis in a Global Setting.
items.abstract: The evolution of multiple sclerosis (MS) diagnostic criteria over the past 4 decades has shortened the time to diagnosis of MS, enabling earlier institution of immunomodulatory therapy and therefore improved clinical outcomes. In response to a recent expansion of knowledge related to approaches and paraclinical tools that may aid diagnosis of MS and identify causes of MS misdiagnosis, the 2024 McDonald criteria reflect substantive changes and introduce new pathways to MS diagnosis. These revisions carry potential for both earlier and more accurate diagnosis of MS, yet require expertise for their appropriate application in clinical practice and introduce new challenges for global implementation. These changes include expansion of anatomical locations that represent dissemination in space, new paraclinical findings that can substitute for dissemination in time, inclusion of patients with asymptomatic or nonspecific clinical presentations, and recommendations for diagnostic approaches in specific patient populations. These changes also incorporate new paraclinical tools for the first time, including MRI central vein sign and paramagnetic rim lesions, CSF kappa free light chains, and optical coherence tomography. The revised criteria have now unified the diagnostic pathway for clinical presentations typical of MS with attack or progressive onset, and established a new pathway for patients without symptoms or with nonspecific clinical presentations accompanied by MRI findings typical of MS. The 2024 revisions continue to rely on recognition of typical clinical and MRI findings of MS, and additionally recommend specific approaches to pediatric patients, patients with vascular comorbidities, and older patients to further reduce the risk of misdiagnosis. Previous data suggest barriers to implementation, and misunderstanding and misapplication of prior revisions to MS diagnostic criteria that may be associated with misdiagnosis. Implementation of the revised 2024 McDonald criteria globally, particularly in low and low-middle income countries, will require educational outreach, leveraging and maximizing existing resources, and engagement of health care systems to improve access to new technology. This review contextualizes the implications of key revisions in the 2024 criteria for routine clinical care, while providing accessible guidance for its appropriate application with a lens toward nonspecialist clinicians and trainees globally, to ensure early and accurate MS diagnosis.
items.summary_ja:
背景：多発性硬化症（MS）の診断基準は過去40年で進化し、診断までの時間短縮と早期の免疫調節療法開始による臨床成績の改善が可能となった。  
方法：2024年改訂のMcDonald基準は、MS診断に役立つ新たな知見や誤診原因の特定を反映し、解剖学的部位の拡大、時間的拡散の代替となる新しい検査所見、無症候や非特異的症状患者の診断経路の追加、特定患者群への診断推奨を含む。MRIの中心静脈サインやパラ磁性リム病変、脳脊髄液中のカッパフリーライトチェーン、光干渉断層計など新規パラクリニカルツールも導入した。  
結果：典型的なMS発症例と無症候・非特異的症状例の診断経路を統一し、小児、血管合併症、高齢患者への誤診リスク軽減策も盛り込んだ。過去の基準改訂では誤診や誤用の問題が指摘されており、2024年基準の世界的な実施には教育普及や既存資源の活用、医療システムの連携が必要である。  
結論：本改訂はMSの早期かつ正確な診断を促進し、非専門医や研修医にも適用可能な指針を提供することで、グローバルな臨床現場での誤診回避と診断精度向上に寄与する。
items.summary_short_ja: 2024年改訂のMcDonald基準は、多発性硬化症（MS）の診断を早期かつ正確に行うために、解剖学的範囲の拡大や新たなパラクリニカル検査（MRI中心静脈徴候、CSFカッパフリーライトチェーンなど）を導入した。無症状や非特異的症状の患者にも対応し、小児や高齢者、血管合併症患者への診断指針も示す。世界的な適用には専門知識と教育が必要で、特に低所得国での普及が課題である。
